title: Graduate Engineer Apprentice (GEA) / Technician (Diploma) Apprentices (TA)
age_limit: Maximum age of 25 years or less as on 31-12-2026. Relaxations apply for reserved categories.

important_dates.label: Last date for submitting online applications
Release of offer letters to provisionally selected candidates

summary: Electronics Corporation of India Limited (ECIL) invites online applications from eligible Indian nationals for the engagement of Graduate Engineer Apprentices (GEA) and Technician Diploma Apprentices (TA) under the Apprenticeship Act, 1961 for a one-year training period at Hyderabad. Selection will be based on document verification and qualifying examination merit. Interested candidates must register on the NATS portal and submit their online application through the ECIL website.
eligibility_bullets: Candidates must have passed B.E./B.Tech or a 3-year Diploma course in relevant engineering branches (ECE, CSE/IT, Mechanical, EEE, EIE, Civil, Chemical) on or after 1st April 2024.
Maximum age limit is 25 years as on 31-12-2026, with admissible relaxations for SC/ST, OBC (NCL), and PwD candidates.
Must be an Indian resident residing anywhere in India.
Candidates who have previously undergone or are currently undergoing apprenticeship under the Apprenticeship Act 1961 are not eligible.

vacancy_breakdown.notes: Combined total distributed across 200 Engineering Graduate seats and 42 Diploma seats across multiple branches including CSE/IT, Mechanical, EEE, EIE, Civil, and Chemical.

how_to_apply_steps: Register yourself on the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) portal at www.nats.education.gov.in.
Submit the online application through the official ECIL website at www.ecil.co.in under Careers > Current Job Openings.
Take a printout of the registered online application form with the system-generated application serial number for future references.
